description: The NMSU filter collection at Apache Point Observatory comprises broad-band U, B, V, R, I filters, Washington system filters (Wash_C2, Wash_C3, Wash_M2), DDO51, and narrow-band H-alpha and [SII] filters used by New Mexico State University and ARC consortium observers on the ARC 3.5-meter telescope.
facility_description: The ARC 3.5-meter Telescope is an optical and infrared telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in the Sacramento Mountains of New Mexico, owned and operated by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
notes: NMSU-UW institutional filter collection for the ARC 3.5m telescope. Traces are hosted in the NMSU-UW-Filters directory on the APO filter server subject to NMSU copyright terms requiring permission for reproduction.
